subject: BrightLayer renewal: bake-off & deployment safeguards
messages:
From: Claire Dobson <claire@brightlayer.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal - BrightLayer account (June)

Vanessa —

We're starting renewal conversations internally for our June 30 cutoff. I need to be transparent: the platform team has initiated a bake-off between Redwood, NimbusAI, and CloudServe. Their pitch is lower unit cost for high-throughput inference and a promise of tighter p50/p95 latency in eu/us traffic.

Key asks from BrightLayer:
- Can Redwood run a side-by-side benchmark using our prompt set and production-sequence distributions?
- Updated pricing for a committed-dedicated pool (20% capacity uplift) and any pilot pricing for a short-term trial.
- Proof points for cross-region failover and audit logs (we'll include procurement on this thread).

I've attached our renewal timeline and a short list of prompts. Procurement will follow up for SOW/PO language.

Thanks,
Claire
Claire Dobson
Head of Platform Operations, BrightLayer
Attachment: BrightLayer_Renewal_Timeline.xlsx

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Claire Dobson <claire@brightlayer.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, rohan_mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-15T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal - BrightLayer account (June)

Claire — thanks for the heads up and the timeline. We're prepared to run a controlled bake-off and provide binding operational commitments for a renewal. Quick proposal:

1) 2-hour side-by-side benchmark run (Redwood hosted + your workload) using your prompt set and sequence distribution; we capture latency percentiles, tokens/sec, and memory/KV behavior.
2) Dedicated pilot pool with a one-month commit and a pilot discount (15%) for the trial. If you proceed to a 12-month commitment for +20% capacity, we'll lock price and extend a 25% unit discount on that tranche.
3) Regional failover playbook and a short SOC2 evidence packet for procurement.

Neha — can you lead the benchmark config (model variants, sequence lengths, env)? Rohan — I want CS on standby for the pilot run and handoff. I'll draft a light SOW and MAP and attach it here for Claire to review.

Available times to run the benchmark next week (PST): Tue 6/1 9–12am, Wed 6/2 1–4pm. Which works for you?

— Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192
Attachment: BrightLayer_Quick_MAP.pdf

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, rohan_mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-15T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal - BrightLayer account (June)

Vanessa / Rohan —

Quick notes on benchmark config so we're aligned before we send a formal plan to BrightLayer:
- Model variants: rwd-large-fp16 (production baseline) + rwd-large-8bit (quantized candidate).
- Input distribution: use BrightLayer supplied prompt set (avg length 96 tokens, 95th 420 tokens).
- Metrics to capture: p50/p95 token latency, end-to-end request latency, tokens/sec, cold-start latency, and KV cache hit ratio.
- Test harness: run 3x 20-minute windows at increasing concurrency (1, 8, 32).
- Isolation: we'll spin a dedicated pool in us-west and a warm fallback in us-east for failover demo.

I'll prepare the harness and a CSV of latency expectations. Attaching a short sample output we'll generate: latency_benchmarks_05-15.csv

Neha
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: latency_benchmarks_05-15.csv

From: Claire Dobson <claire@brightlayer.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightLayer Procurement <procurement@brightlayer.com>
Date: 2027-05-16T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal - BrightLayer account (June)

Vanessa / Neha —

Thanks for the quick reply. Wed 6/2 1–4pm PST works for our infra team. Procurement is cc'd — they want a short SOW and clear remediation/credit language if SLOs aren't met.

A few additional asks before the run:
- Can you commit to run the benchmark using our representative traffic (we'll provide a tokenized sample)?
- Can Redwood provide a PoC-level SLA for the pilot (uptime + latency p95) that we can show to execs?
- We also need a DocuSign SOW template for procurement review.

Claire
Attachment: (referenced prompt set in prior email)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Claire Dobson <claire@brightlayer.com>, BrightLayer Procurement <procurement@brightlayer.com>
Cc: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, rohan_mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-17T14:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal - BrightLayer account (June) — SOW & pilot terms

Claire / Procurement —

Attached is a short SOW and MAP covering the pilot bake-off and the proposed renewal commercial terms:
- Pilot: 1-month dedicated pool (20% capacity uplift) with a 15% pilot discount. Includes 2 benchmark windows + post-run analysis.
- Renewal offer (if you convert within 30 days): 12-month term, price lock, 25% discount on the committed tranche, and a 60-day rollback window if performance regressions are detected.
- SLOs for committed pool: 99.9% availability, p95 inference latency SLA to be agreed post-benchmark. Service credits scale with missed SLO milestones.
- Operational commits: regional failover playbook, audit log access, and two joint runbooks for on-call escalation during rollout.

We're including a DocuSign link for the SOW and a short technical appendix describing the benchmark harness. Please let me know if procurement needs alternate legal language.

Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_bakeoff_sow_v1.pdf
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/sign/bL-4827-quote

From: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.com>
To: Claire Dobson <claire@brightlayer.com>, BrightLayer Procurement <procurement@brightlayer.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-18T16:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal - BrightLayer account (June) — bakeoff logistics

Claire / procurement team —

I'll be your primary CS lead for the bake-off and will coordinate the run with Neha. A couple logistical notes:
- Please share your tokenized sample and a network egress IP allowlist by EOD Monday so we can provision the pilot pool.
- Our engineer will join at 12:30pm PST on Wed 6/2 to validate the harness before the 1pm start.
- We will provide a post-run artifact bundle (bench CSV, raw traces, and a condensed executive summary) within 48 hours.

Attaching the quick instructions we'll send to your infra team so they can prepare the workload runner.

Rohan Mehta
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachment: Bakeoff_instructions.txt
